- **DWG FastView (Overseas Growth & Monetization Manager, 2019–Present)**: Scaled global user acquisition to 1.5M+ DAU across Mobile, PC & Web. Manage 12+ multi-language official websites (`en.dwgfastview.com`, `kr.dwgfastview.com`, `blog.dwgfastview.com`, etc.) and 27 overseas PC distribution channels. Own global subscription monetization across Google Play, Apple App Store, and 2Checkout plus Ad Mediation, backed by automated Python GA4/GSC data pipelines.
- **KingCamp (`kingcamp.com` / `kingcampoutdoors.com`) & Yoybuy (`yoybuy.com`)**: Served as Fractional Technical SEO & Google Ads Consultant (re-engaged by former employer Yoybuy), resolving technical SEO bottlenecks, restructuring high-intent keyword taxonomy, and scaling Google Search/Shopping ROAS across North America and Europe.
- **PostPony US Logistics SaaS (`postpony.com`), Clash of Kings (Elex Wireless) & Perfect Optimizer (ClickBank)**: Led digital growth at PostPony (20 consecutive months of GMV growth via Google/FB Ads & Dealmoon); managed global affiliate networks (ClickBank, ShareASale, Webgains) and user acquisition for *Clash of Kings* and *Perfect Optimizer*.
